summary: AIR Global PLC furnished a Form 6-K with Q3 2026 results, a results presentation and a shareholder letter. The release reports Q3 revenue up 11.1% YoY to $99.8M and Adjusted EBITDA up 7.7% to $30.9M, and discloses capital-return and financing actions: an annual dividend of $0.28 per share beginning Q1 2027 paid quarterly, up to $100M of share repurchases through December 2029 funded by equity free cash flow, and $425M of 7.875% senior unsecured notes due 2031 issued October 1, 2026. No price, premium or board recommendation is stated. Watch buyback execution pace and leverage trajectory toward the 2.0x target by December 2027.
